name: Negative Event Feedback to Mattermost
description: Analyze Typeform event feedback with Amazon Comprehend and notify Mattermost only for negative sentiment.
requirements: Typeform Personal Access Token with webhook-management access, a feedback form and public HTTPS callback
AWS IAM access key with comprehend:DetectSentiment permission in the configured region; access key ID and secret access key stored as secret Variables, plus a session token for temporary credentials
Public HTTPS Mattermost server and Personal Access Token allowed to post in the selected channel
Feedback text in the configured language within Amazon Comprehend’s 5 KB limit; complete Open Flow webhook body at most 64 KiB
